title: Senior Demand Planner
description:
Senior Demand Planner

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Salary: Competitive + Benefits + Bonus


If you are an agile, analytical and detail-oriented senior supply chain professional, with experience gained in global demand planning and order management, then we want to hear from you.


Join us to help improve peoples' lives and make healthcare better for everyone!


Why Pharmanovia?


Pharmanovia is a dynamic, fast-growing international pharmaceutical company with a portfolio of over 20 brands across more than 160 markets. Our mission is to improve patient health globally through the revitalisation of niche, tried-and-trusted medicines.


Our core behaviours are:


  • We act decisively but we never compromise on quality.
  • We keep our promises and do as we say.
  • We value our heritage and foster an entrepreneurial spirit.
  • We reinvest in our future – in our products, our brands and our people.
  • We give back to our communities.


Since its inception in 2013, Pharmanovia has grown consistently year on year, focusing on delivering high-quality branded prescription medicines to patients, prescribers, and healthcare providers across the world. Our growth has enabled the company to reinvest in its products, brands, people, and to give back to its communities. A people business with a strong, supportive culture that encourages innovation and entrepreneurial spirit, our team comprises over 300 employees and 29 nationalities, operating from offices in the UK, Denmark, Netherlands, Switzerland, Italy, Spain, Germany, U.A.E., India, China, Australia and Singapore.


We are an agile, committed, and innovative global specialty pharma business and a preferred partner for innovator pharma companies, instigating a paradigm shift in the life cycle management of iconic medicines. We seek to extensively engage with clinical communities to communicate product improvements and prioritise environmental, social, and governance considerations across the business and workforce.


Pharmanovia’s therapeutic areas include Cardiovascular, Oncology, Endocrinology and Neurology.


About the role:


As Senior Demand Planner you will manage end-to-end order fulfilment in a hybrid make-to-order/make-to-stock environment. You will oversee the supply flow from customer order receipt through delivery, ensuring alignment across Commercial, CMOs, Quality, and Logistics.


Your key responsibilities will include maintaining customer communication, managing demand and production planning inputs, coordinating timely supply from manufacturing partners, ensuring compliant product release, and securing on-time shipment.


Demand Planning: supporting global demand visibility and forecasting accuracy through:

  • Partnering with commercial teams to collect and validate market-level forecasts
  • Reviewing historical sales trends and current inventory positions
  • Consolidating forecasts to feed into S&OP and supply planning cycles


Order Management: overseeing the full customer order lifecycle, including:

  • Receiving and processing purchase orders from global customers and distributors
  • Entering and confirming orders in the ERP system and tracking through to shipment
  • Coordinating with logistics and warehousing for dispatch and delivery
  • Proactively communicating order status and resolving delays or issues
  • Managing returns, write-offs, and documentation in line with policy


We’re looking for a Senior Demand Planner who is well-organised, attentive to detail, and proactive, with the confidence to communicate effectively with both internal stakeholders and external partners. You should be able to demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, an inquisitive mindset, and a willingness to develop and expand your technical capabilities.


The role reports directly to the Supply Chain Manager. The department has an ethos of continuous improvement, refining systems and creating efficiencies, leading to a varied and dynamic working environment.


Main responsibilities & duties:

  • Managing new customer purchase orders and entering them into the ERP system
  • Checking order status, stock availability, and shipment timelines
  • Communicating with logistics, CMOs, and internal stakeholders to ensure dispatch readiness
  • Managing demand planning by gathering and consolidating forecast data from commercial teams, analyzing historical sales trends and current inventory levels to ensure optimal stock coverage and alignment with business needs in MTS and MTO
  • Tracking backorders, delays, and inventory risks
  • Aligning with commercial teams on upcoming tenders, launches, or demand shifts
  • Responding to customer enquiries about order status or documentation
  • Updating trackers, KPIs, and ERP data for accuracy
  • Leading S&OP planning and stock reconciliation for forecast accuracy
  • Identifying improvement areas before building business cases and engaging with relevant stakeholders to obtain their engagement and buy-in to develop a new tool and/or propose a plan of action which will contribute towards our innovation, performance or trust priorities
  • Troubleshooting all issues within the supply chain process relevant to bridging stock, serialisation, and tamper evidence, whilst ensuring the highest standard of GDP is maintained
  • Managing the process of inventory returns from customer or distribution channels, and evaluating returned inventory for potential restocking or disposal, following company guidelines
  • Performing Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable financial reconciliation with regional partners as part of the order-to-cash process, ensuring accuracy in invoicing, payment application, and credit management


About you:


Candidates with progressive experience in supply chain, demand planning, order management, or customer operations within pharmaceuticals, FMCG, medical devices, or another regulated/GDP environment, should have the skills and experience required for the role. We are also looking for:


  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, Operations Management, or related field
  • APICS, CIPS, IBF, or other supply chain certification desirable
  • Experience working within Supply Chain - S&OP, Demand Planning, Demand Forecasting in the pharma environment
  • Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Navision, JD Edwards)
  • Excellent computer skills with high proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with a good understanding of Power BI
  • Proven track record in managing purchase orders, forecasting, stock coordination, or order-to-cash
  • Exposure to S&OP and/or global distribution desirable
  • Knowledge of inventory monitoring, inventory valuation methods, inventory methods, inventory control principles, and best practice
  • Excellent coordination skills and ability to manage multiple customer orders simultaneously
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret sales trends, stock levels, and forecast data
  • High attention to accuracy and detail in documentation, system entries, and communication
  • Confident communicator across internal teams (Commercial, QA, Logistics, Finance, CMOs) and external customers
  • Proactive problem-solver with the ability to anticipate supply issues and propose solutions
  • Comfortable working to deadlines in a fast-paced, multi-market environment
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


To apply please submit your CV in English.

By applying for this role, your details will be sent to Ortolan People, who are engaged to provide recruitment support in processing applications. We will endeavour to respond to all applicants within three working days. Occasionally for roles with a very high volume of applicants, this may not be possible.

  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.


Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Consultor (a) Storage - Híbrido
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


STORAGE JOB DESCRIPTION:


  • Advanced English


  • Good Knowledge on components and architectures.


  • In depth understanding of the HPE Alletra, HP 3PAR, Nimble.


  • Hands on experience with storage array migrations.


  • Experience in SAN storage backup and recovery and exposure to SAN Data replication tools.


  • Experience on Cisco and Brocade fabric switch/Directors. Configuring new switch, upgrades, zoning, VSAN and troubleshooting.


  • Experience of SAN allocation, deallocation.


  • Good Knowledge on RAID concepts, inline data deduplication, inline data compression.


  • Dynamic LUN Provisioning, Zoning, storage firmware upgrades


  • Allocating Boot luns in VMware environment


  • Troubleshooting storage related and compatibility related issues.


  • Allocating LUNs to different operating systems like MS Windows, VMWare ESX/ESXi, Linux and Solaris/AIX/HPUX.


  • Exposure to performance tuning techniques for SAN and NAS


  • Experience in handling major incident bridges, critical issues.


  • Good in scripting and automating the standard storage procedures.


  • Should be familiar with ITIL processes.


Roles & Responsibilities – Storage (HPE 3PAR / Alletra)



1. Design, architect, and deploy HPE 3PAR and Alletra storage solutions based on customer business, performance, and availability requirements.


2. Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to understand workload needs and propose optimal storage designs.


3. Manage 3PAR/Alletra arrays including CPGs, virtual volumes, VLUNs, host sets, and port configurations.


4. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex storage, SAN, and performance issues.


5. Plan and execute storage migrations using Peer Motion, Online Import, and host-based migration tools with minimal downtime.


6. Administer and troubleshoot SAN fabrics (Brocade/Cisco) including zoning, ISLs, firmware upgrades, and fabric resiliency.


7. Optimize storage performance and efficiency through RAID selection, tiering, chunklet layout, and adaptive optimization.


8. Implement and manage replication and DR solutions such as Remote Copy, Peer Persistence, and metro cluster configurations.


9. Integrate storage with virtualization and OS platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Linux, Windows) and resolve multipathing issues.


10. Manage firmware, OS, and controller upgrades ensuring non-disruptive operations and rollback readiness.


11. Leverage HPE InfoSight and SSMC for proactive monitoring, capacity forecasting, and health analysis.


12. Coordinate with backup teams and customers to integrate storage with Commvault / NetBackup for application-consistent backups.


13. Prepare and deliver technical presentations to customers on storage architecture, performance analysis, and solution proposals.


14. Provide regular operational and executive-level reports covering capacity utilization, performance trends, risks, and recommendations.


15. Act as escalation point for critical production incidents and major outages.


16. Collaborate with application, database, network, and virtualization teams to align storage design with end-to-end solutions.


17. Ensure security, compliance, and governance through encryption, RBAC, audit logging, and best-practice controls.


18. Automate and standardize storage operations using CLI, REST APIs, and scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.


19. Mentor L1/L2 engineers and review change requests, SOPs, and implementation plans.


20. Participate in CAB meetings, customer reviews, and vendor engagements (HPE) while supporting 24×7 mission-critical environments.

title: Staff Software Development in Test Engineer (SDET)
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth.

Job Description

Overview

We are looking for an exceptional and highly experienced Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our quality engineering team. This is a crucial individual contributor role responsible for designing, building, and maintaining advanced test automation frameworks, driving innovative testing practices, and significantly raising the quality bar across the entire development lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a deep technical expert and a proactive mentor.

This is a remote role in all over Brazil geolocation!

Key Responsibilities

Technical Design & Framework Ownership

  • Architect and Develop: Design, develop, and implement highly scalable, reliable, and maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch across multiple platforms (e.g., web, API, backend services).

  • Technical Authority: Serve as the technical authority on testing methodologies, tools, and best practices. Evaluate and integrate new automated tools and technologies into the existing test infrastructure.

  • Code Quality: Drive high standards for test code quality, structure, and maintainability, including code reviews for automation scripts and framework contributions from SDET team.

  • Non-Functional Testing: Design and execute advanced non-functional tests, including performance and load tests, and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline.

Quality Strategy & Process Improvement

  • Quality Advocate: Partner with development and product teams to integrate testing practices early in the development lifecycle (Shift-Left). Advocate for and implement robust quality gates and coverage metrics.

  • CI/CD Integration: Own and optimize the integration of automated tests into the Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline to ensure rapid feedback and zero defect leakage to production.

  • Troubleshooting: Expertly debug and analyze complex system failures, identifying root causes in both application code and test infrastructure.

Mentorship & Leadership

  • Mentorship: Coach and mentor junior and mid-level SDETs and software engineers on technical design, testing strategy, and effective automation techniques.

  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for test strategies, automation frameworks, and best practices to enable self-service quality for all engineers.

  • Technical Strategy: Contribute significantly to the long-term quality roadmap and technology choices alongside Engineering Managers and Principal Engineers.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

  • Minimum of 7+ years of professional experience in a hands-on SDET, Automation Engineer, or Quality Engineer role.

  • Expert proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C#, Go) used for building production-level code and automation frameworks.

  • Proven experience designing and scaling test automation frameworks (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalents) for complex, large-scale applications.

  • Deep practical knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, data structures, and algorithms.

  • Excellent ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and influence cross-functional technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a domain-specific area (e.g., cloud infrastructure, machine learning, financial systems).

  • Experience with advanced mocking/stubbing tools and service virtualization.

  • Certifications in cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Additional Information



Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

description:
Position Overview

The Regional Manager – Brazil & LATAM will lead the commercial expansion of Whale TV’s business across Brazil and key Latin American markets. Acting as the strategic bridge between ODMs in China and local TV brands and retailers , this role is responsible for driving market growth, establishing strategic partnerships, and ensuring regional product-market alignment. The role will work closely with internal departments— Product Management, Quality Assurance, Content, Marketing and Monetization —to tailor product and service for the LATAM market.

The Regional Manager will also collaborate directly with decision makers at HQ to align business strategies, present internal reports, and drive key initiatives that support company growth in the region.

Work Location: São Paulo, Brazil (relocation is welcome)

Travel Requirement: Structured business travel to LATAM countries and China (details below).

Business Development & Sales

  • Develop and execute strategies to grow Smart TV sales in Brazil and across LATAM.
  • Build and manage relationships with local TV brands and major retailers (offline and online).
  • Lead commercial negotiations, sales forecasting, and business planning.
  • Track key performance indicators(e.g., sales volume, partnership completion rate) analyzing data, and propose optimization actions.

ODM Coordination & Product Execution:

  • Align product requirements, timelines, and localization needs.
  • Coordinate with Content, Marketing, QA, Tech and PM to ensure successful delivery to market.

Retail & Channel Engagement

  • Oversee in-market execution across key retail partners and e-commerce channels.
  • Manage positioning and promotional activities.
  • Work with monetization team on expansion of Retail Media Networks .

Strategic Alignment & Internal Collaboration

  • Align regional strategy with HQ.
  • Prepare and present internal performance reports, forecasts, and market analysis.
  • Coordinate internal cross-departmental projects to improve regional business efficiency and brand visibility

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Marketing, International Trade, Electronic Engineering, or related fields are preferred
  • 5 to 8 years of experience in consumer electronics(in the Smart TV industry is a plus).
  • Proven success in regional sales, business development, or channel partnership in Brazil and Latin America .
  • Experience working with or managing ODM partnerships (China) and cross-border business.
  • Knowledge of LATAM retail ecosystems and go-to-market dynamics.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (proficiency Spanish or Chinese is a big plus).
  • Excellent communication and teamwork.

We’re looking for a Systems Engineer to help build, automate, and support development and test environments across a large-scale platform. You’ll play a key role in designing, deploying, and optimising cloud and on-prem environments that support critical applications from build through to production support.

What you’ll do

  • Build and manage development & test environments across on-prem and AWS platforms
  • Automate infrastructure and platform tasks using Python , Ansible , and Flux
  • Deploy and support applications on Kubernetes (including Helm-based deployments)

  • Monitor platforms and applications, implementing automated testing and health checks
  • Troubleshoot complex platform and deployment issues
  • Collaborate closely with development and operations teams

What you’ll bring

  • Strong automation and scripting experience with Python
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised platforms
  • Experience deploying applications using Helm
  • Understanding of JSON and its relationship to YANG
  • Solid grasp of cyber security principles and compliance
  • Foundational networking knowledge
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

Nice to have

Location: Fully Remote

Role type: Contract

If you enjoy building reliable platforms through automation and working across modern cloud and container technologies, we’d love to hear from you.

title: RippleX Partner Director
description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Are you a strategic leader with deep experience in relationship management and a passion for tokenization, institutional finance, and blockchain technology? As a Partner Director on the RippleX Partner Success team, you'll play a key role in accelerating the growth and impact of the XRPL ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of high-profile partners—including financial institutions, fintechs, and crypto-native builders—guiding them through every stage of their journey: from idea to integration to go-live and scale.

This is not a passive role. You will be hands-on in shaping tokenization strategies, architecting utility on-chain, and removing roadblocks in dynamic, high-stakes environments. Your day-to-day will span deep technical discussions and executive-level strategic planning—always with the goal of maximizing partner success and driving meaningful, on-ledger activity.

If you're excited to unlock real-world utility through tokenized assets and thrive at the intersection of institutional finance and blockchain innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own and lead a portfolio of highly strategic and complex Institutional DeFi partners building on XRPL, with a focus on scaled adoption of tokenized asset use cases.
  • Define and drive strategic account plans that maximize long-term value for both Ripple and its partners.
  • Lead execution across technical and GTM workstreams, anticipating risks and aligning cross-functional resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Provide thought leadership and guidance to partners around tokenization, utility, regulatory considerations, and financial market structures.
  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships with C-level stakeholders at partner organizations, and act as a senior voice across Ripple internal teams.
  • Represent partner needs and priorities internally, influencing RippleX’s roadmap, product strategy, and go-to-market motions.
  • Identify opportunities for broader ecosystem impact and partner cross-collaboration to accelerate XRPL utility.
  • Travel to partner and customer sites as needed (20–30%).

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 10–12+ years of experience leading strategic partnerships or enterprise engagements in fintech, financial services, or blockchain—ideally with a focus on innovation and emerging tech.
  • Institutional Finance Acumen: Deep understanding of financial instruments and market structure (equities, bonds, repos, collateralized lending, etc.). Strong grasp of collateral management, capital efficiency, and how DeFi can impact these processes. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (Basel III, MiFID, EMIR, etc.) and how they relate to tokenisation and digital asset adoption
  • Tokenization Expertise: Strong command of tokenization models, use cases, and best practices. Able to influence strategy and guide partner implementation across the asset lifecycle.
  • Blockchain Fluency: Deep understanding of blockchain fundamentals and how they can be applied to financial use cases such as tokenization, settlement, and collateral management. Ability to evaluate different protocol features (e.g., scalability, finality, cost, security) and articulate how they impact institutional DeFi applications. Experience advising on interoperability protocols and bridging technologies (e.g., Axelar) to support cross-chain integration and ecosystem connectivity.
  • Go-to-Market & Utility Creation: Proven track record of launching scalable GTM strategies that result in sustained on-chain activity and partner adoption. Ability to cross-pollinate within Ripple and across partners.
  • Partner Enablement & Growth: Extensive experience leading strategic partnerships and enterprise relationships, with a focus on enabling partners from ideation through to build, compliance readiness, and scaled deployment. Adept at managing complex stakeholder dynamics across technical, product, and executive functions. Proven ability to proactively remove obstacles and shape partner strategy to drive momentum, unlock long-term value, and deliver measurable impact on ecosystem growth.
  • Problem Solving with Agency: Bias for action and proactive problem solving, especially when navigating ambiguity or institutional inertia. Strong “ownership mindset” to help partners go from idea to deployment with confidence. Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset—skilled at managing through ambiguity, resolving friction, and anticipating downstream impact.
  • Executive Presence & Trust Building: Experienced engaging at the C-suite level at tier 1 banks and asset managers, with credibility, empathy, and strategic insight. Trusted advisor in high-stakes conversations. Skilled in managing sensitive conversations (regulatory risk, commercial conflicts, etc.).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Comfortable driving alignment and influencing roadmaps across multiple internal teams to ensure success at scale.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

title: Analista de Negócios - Sênior (Informes Legais)
description:
Descrição da vaga

O Grupo Daycoval é formado por um time de pessoas engajadas e de bom astral. Todos imbuídos de fazer diferença nas vidas de nossos clientes. Sabemos o quanto o mercado financeiro é desafiador e de alta demanda – é disso que gostamos.

Nosso mercado está frenético com a entrada do mundo digital e por aqui atuamos em transformar nossos processos de forma ativa.

A área de Projetos de TI com Foco em Normas Regulatórias é responsável por gerenciar e executar projetos tecnológicos que garantem a conformidade do banco com todas as regulamentações impostas pelos órgãos governamentais e reguladores, como o Banco Central do Brasil (Bacen). Essa área atua de forma transversal, colaborando com todas as unidades de negócios do banco, garantindo que as soluções de TI implementadas estejam alinhadas com as normas e diretrizes regulatórias vigentes. Ela também assegura que os sistemas e processos atendam aos padrões de segurança, controle e relatórios exigidos pelas autoridades reguladoras.

Buscamos Especialista com experiência no segmento financeiro para gerenciar equipe de PROJETOS focado(a) em atendimento de demandas relacionadas aos produtos Empréstimos (Capital de Giro, BNDES), Financiamentos (Imóveis, Veículos), Antecipação de Recebíveis, Conta Garantida, entre outros;

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Entender e gerenciar demandas das áreas usuárias.
  • Gerenciar demandas junto aos fornecedores internos e externos, garantindo que as necessidades das áreas usuárias cheguem de forma clara, bem como que as entregas dos fornecedores atendam as expectativas de prazo e a qualidade.
  • Mensurar esforços, elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas para implantação de projetos.
  • Promover a integração e mobilização de todos os envolvidos no projeto, garantindo qualidade de comunicação, de sistemas e cumprimento dos prazos estipulados.
  • Mensurar as expectativas de retorno para cada projeto.
  • Conduzir estudos de oportunidades de evoluções sistêmicas e de negócio em conjunto com a área usuária.
  • Elaborar e apresentar status do andamento dos projetos para os gestores das áreas envolvidas nos projetos.
  • Requisitos e qualificações:

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo
  • Experiência em projetos de tecnologia/sistemas.
  • Conhecimentos de SQLServer.
  • Conhecimentos de fluxos e produtos bancários: Empréstimos, Financiamentos, Antecipação de Recebíveis, Conta Garantida, Fiança, entre outros;
  • Bons conhecimentos relacionados à geração de Informes Legais para o Banco Central - Sistema de Informações de Créditos (SCR) – CADOC 3040 e CADOC 3050;
  • Bons conhecimentos relacionados à Resolução 4.966 e afins – Definições de bases para mensuração da perda esperada (PDD);
  • Bons conhecimentos relacionados à contabilidade de produtos bancários referentes a operações de crédito.
  • Competências comportamentais que serão avaliadas durante o processo: comunicação, capacidade de priorização, capacidade de resolução de problemas, capacidade de adaptação a mudanças e capacidade de raciocínio lógico;

title: Assistente Tributário
description:
Inovação. Tecnologia e Sustentabilidade.

Na Vallourec, somos mais do que uma empresa: somos um parceiro confiável que cria soluções inovadoras para os setores de energia, indústria e construção.

Com mais de 120 anos de história, presença em 20 países nos cinco continentes e mais de 13.000 colaboradores, estamos na vanguarda da tecnologia e da sustentabilidade.

Nossa atuação abrange:

✅ Óleo e Gás – soluções para exploração e extração nas condições mais extremas

✅ Indústria – tubos resistentes e leves para diversas aplicações

✅ Novas Energias – geotermia, hidrogênio e captura de carbono (CCUS)

Com espírito pioneiro, investimos em digitalização, serviços inteligentes e soluções para a transição energética, mantendo nossa liderança tecnológica e criando valor para nossos clientes.

No Brasil, contamos com uma sólida atuação e unidades estratégicas:

Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Espírito Santo – produção de tubos de aço com e sem costura e soluções tubulares para indústria em geral

Florestal – produção de carvão vegetal para abastecimento dos altos-fornos

⛏ Mineração – fornecimento interno de minério de ferro

Com presença global e forte atuação local, nosso objetivo é estar cada vez mais próximo dos clientes, garantindo competitividade, inovação e excelência.

Resumo da posição: Assistente Tributário – Procure to Pay (CSC)

Você será responsável por apoiar as atividades tributárias do processo Procure to Pay no CSC, garantindo a escrituração correta das notas fiscais, tratativas de divergências e interface com áreas internas e fornecedores, assegurando conformidade e eficiência nos processos.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Escrituração de notas fiscais no SAP.
  • Tratativas de divergências via Power Automate e e-mails.
  • Interface com usuários que emitem pedidos, carta chamadas e áreas de logística, almoxarifados e suprimentos.
  • Liberação das notas fiscais para contas a pagar.
  • Elaboração de relatórios e KPIs.
  • Desenvolvimento de ferramentas e dashboards em Power BI.
  • Relacionamento com fornecedores.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em andamento em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Administração ou áreas afins OU curso técnico em Contabilidade.
  • Experiência em revisão e escrituração de notas fiscais, contas a pagar e áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência com SAP.
  • Inglês Intermediário.

Benefícios oferecidos:

Nosso compromisso é oferecer a você um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e seguro, onde seu talento possa alcançar o máximo potencial. Para isso, disponibilizamos um pacote de benefícios completo e pensado para garantir qualidade de vida, bem-estar e desenvolvimento contínuo:

  • Participação nos lucros e resultados (PLR).
  • Plano de previdência privada diferenciado.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Transporte (estratégia definida conforme nível da posição).
  • Assistência médica e odontológica.
  • Alimentação subsidiada na empresa (refeitório).
  • Vale alimentação.
  • Cesta de natal / Brinquedos e material escolar para filhos/dependentes diretos.
  • Abono retorno de férias.
  • Complementação de auxílio previdenciário.
  • Auxílio Creche / Auxílio Natalidade.
  • COOVALL (cooperativa de crédito).
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass).
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação.
  • Ambiente inovador e oportunidades de carreira global.

Se você busca um ambiente global, dinâmico e com oportunidades de crescimento, a Vallourec é o lugar certo para você!

title: National Sales Manager - Brazil
description:
Job Purpose: Develop, drive implementation and track the sales strategy within a defined therapy area for Brazil to grow the business within regulatory norms and organizational policies with the objective of increasing sales volume and doctor coverage thereby creating a positive impact on market share and ranking of Cipla in the industry.

Key Accountabilities:

Develop the sales plan and strategy and drive its implementation for products within a therapy area in Brazil in order to achieve desired business outcomes and enhance ranking in the industry:

Prepare bottom up sales forecast for the year and break it down by month

Participate in discussions with stakeholders to finalize targets for the year, break down finalized targets among different therapy heads after discussions with them, set standards for sales processes

Monitor field processes' compliance through cycle reviews, conduct timely reviews and evaluate plans for relevancy

Analyse tier two markets and identify distribution gaps and recommend appointment of stockists

Study market data and monitor Cipla performance vs market performance

Drive territory data management in order to plan for and implement the best of class coverage:

Network with industry peers to gather data on doctor coverage

Monitor updating of doctors' list on a monthly basis by the team

Monitor data to ensure that the sales team meets the right doctors at the right frequency and distribute the right inputs

Drive customer relationship management with the concerned stakeholders in order to achieve the desired ROI without deviating from prescribed policies and increase the prescriber base:

Finalize Commercial Cockpit calendar in coordination with the concerned teams

Identify and select speakers of KOL status and do it in a cost effective manner

Maintain and strengthen relationships with critical KOLs

Plan, and drive new product launches in the respective therapy area in Brazil in order to ensure complete preparedness of the sales team for the launch and successful launch of the product

Drive implementation of the launch plan (execution excellence) in line with the marketing teams' strategy through preselection and targeting

Collaborate with Distribution team to ensure availability of the new product, formulate a plan for high impact launch, ensure scientific knowledge of team members through training sessions in quarterly meetings

Monitor data to ensure that the sales team meets the right doctors at the right frequency and distribute the right inputs for new products

Track progress with new product launch tracker; review progress of launch on a regular basis with teams

Coordinate with distribution team for stocks

Review achievement of sales numbers versus target;

check implementation process (for launch plan)

Check status of stock availability at depots and suggest corrective action to distribution and Sales team

Identify new opportunities in order to achieve higher ranking and best in class execution excellence

Use market information to identify initiatives to grow the business

Identify capabilities and resources required for implementing relevant initiatives

Formulate plans with accountabilities and milestones, initiate corrective action when required

Develop the team in order to maximize retention and performance of team members

Conduct goal setting, performance appraisals, coach employees

Participate in recruitment and induction, identify training needs

Provide training on specific capabilities and products to team based on future plans and business requirements

Identify and recommend retention plans

Educational qualifications:

B.SC / B.Pharm

Relevant experience:

12 - 18 years of Sales experience

title: Head of Business Unit - Environment & Sustainability | Brazil & Chile
description:
QUADRANTE – Grupo internacional de engenharia, com forte atuação em Energia, Mobilidade e Cidades Sustentáveis, e presença crescente em projetos financiados por instituições financeiras internacionais.

Contexto do Projeto

A QUADRANTE está criando uma Unidade de Negócios de Meio Ambiente para os mercados do Brasil e do Chile, com ambição de se posicionar como referência regional em serviços ambientais integrados à engenharia.

Trata-se de um papel estruturante, com responsabilidade por estratégia, mercado, pessoas e resultados, focado em projetos complexos, regulados e financiados.

Objetivo do Cargo

Criar, liderar e escalar a Unidade de Negócios de Meio Ambiente para Brasil e Chile, assegurando:

  • Posicionamento técnico e institucional de alto nível.
  • Integração efetiva com as demais unidades de negócio.
  • Capacidade de atuar em projetos financiados por IFIs e bancos privados, em conformidade com standards internacionais de desempenho ambiental e social.

Principais Responsabilidades

Estratégia & Negócio

  • Definir e implementar a estratégia regional (Brasil & Chile) da Unidade de Negócios.
  • Estruturar o portfólio de serviços ambientais.
  • Desenvolver e gerir P&L, pipeline e KPIs de crescimento.

Mercado & Comercial

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de mercado e relacionamento com:
  • Clientes públicos e privados
  • Desenvolvedores de projetos
  • Investidores e financiadores
  • Atuar diretamente em propostas estratégicas, negociações complexas e fechamento de contratos.
  • Traduzir tendências regulatórias, ESG e de financiamento sustentável em oportunidades comerciais concretas, tanto do lado do Project Developer como dos Lenders.

Projetos & Standards

  • Liderar e supervisionar projetos financiados, assegurando conformidade com:
  • IFC Performance Standards
  • Equator Principles (EP4)
  • World Bank Environmental and Social Framework
  • Outros referenciais internacionais aplicáveis
  • Garantir alinhamento entre licenciamento ambiental nacional e requisitos de financiadores.
  • Construir uma base de subcontratados de excelência, que reduzam riscos materiais na produção e auxiliem na expansão da marca QUADRANTE.

Pessoas & Organização

  • Construir, desenvolver e liderar equipes locais no Brasil e no Chile.
  • Implementar estruturas organizacionais escaláveis, alinhadas com padrões internacionais.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, institucional e de liderança.

Governance & Integração

  • Trabalhar em coordenação permanente com o Responsável Global de Meio Ambiente.
  • Garantir integração transversal com os negócios de Energia, Mobilidade e Cidades Sustentáveis.
  • Representar a QUADRANTE junto a stakeholders institucionais e estratégicos.

Experiência

  • Executivo(a) sênior com mínimo de 15 anos de experiência em Meio Ambiente ou Environmental & Social Advisory.
  • Experiência sólida em projetos nacionais, complexos e financiados, preferencialmente em contextos multinacionais.
  • Vivência profissional relevante no Brasil, com capacidade de atuação regional.
  • Histórico comprovado de:

Criação ou escalabilidade de unidades de negócio

Desenvolvimento de mercado e liderança comercial

Gestão de equipas técnicas multidisciplinares

Conhecimento Técnico:

  • Domínio prático de:
  • Licenciamento ambiental no Brasil e/ou Chile
  • Standards internacionais (IFC PS, EP4, World Bank ESF, etc.)
  • Background técnico eclético, com formação e/ou experiência nas dimensões: Social, Biológica e Física

Competências-Chave

  • Perfil Comercial: negociação, influência e relacionamento institucional.
  • Espírito empreendedor e mentalidade de construção (“builder mindset”).
  • Forte capacidade de adaptação cultural e atuação em contextos regulatórios diversos.
  • Liderança madura, colaborativa e orientada a resultados.
  • Conforto em estruturas matriciais e ambientes de elevada exigência técnica.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (Brasil, Chile e internacional).

Idiomas

  • Português fluente
  • Espanhol fluente
  • Inglês avançado

title: Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Truck Center - Inovação em Sistemas
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Truck Center é uma empresa paranaense com mais de 35 anos de atuação no desenvolvimento de equipamentos e softwares automotivos para alinhamento, balanceamento e serviços de pneus em veículos leves e pesados. Com forte foco em tecnologia, precisão e melhoria contínua, a empresa se destaca pelo compromisso com inovação e qualidade, oferecendo soluções completas que incluem fabricação, treinamento e suporte técnico. Diante disso, a Truck Center busca avançar em novos desafios, especialmente na criação de sistemas mais modernos e integrados para alinhamento, balanceamento e calibração automotiva.

Projeto: Inovação em sistemas de alinhamento, balanceamento e calibração automotiva.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Mecatrônica, Eletrônica, Física ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Principais Atividades:

  • Testes funcionais dos equipamentos em oficina piloto;
  • Desenvolvimento sistema de calibração de câmeras automotivas;
  • Produção de manuais técnicos.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Visão sistêmica de P&D;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas CAD/CAE Python, sistemas embarcados integração de sensores e sistemas.

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos sobre under car, tanto da linha leve como da linha pesada, sistemas de alinhamento e geometria de veículos e balanceamento de rodas.

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido – Araucária/PR

(Integração presencial - após período de integração possibilidade de atuação híbrida)

Soft Skills : Liderança, Trabalho em equipe, Pensamento Crítico, Criatividade.

Oferecem refeição no local (café da manhã e almoço)

title: Analista de Dados- Pleno
description:

title: HSE Manager
description:
Job description：

1、Implement brazil construction safety laws, regulations, standards and group company documents, supervise the implementation of relevant laws, regulations, standards or documents on the project site, and ensure that the HSE work on the brazil project site meets local regulations.

2、Establishing and improving project safety supervision system, formulating and improving project site safety rules and regulations, safety precautions, safety risk control emergency plan and other safety technical operation documents.

3、Responsible for the supervision and inspection of the safe construction process and the operation of the occupational health and safety management system.

4、Organizing regular or irregular special inspection of safety and civilization construction, putting forward rectification opinions, and tracking and checking the implementation effect of rectification and preventive measures.

5、Organizing and filing security documents and materials, and updating system documents as required by brazil law, including Health and Safety Management Plan (HSMP)、Environment Management Plan (EMP)、Emergency Response Plan.

Qualification：

1、Bachelor degree or above, no major requirement，Familiar with brazil HSE requirements.

2、More than 3 years experience in wind power industry/new energy power industry; Master safety management, electrical and other professional knowledge.

3、With complex situation control ability, excellent communication and coordination ability, with a strong sense of responsibility and responsibility.

4、Fluent in Portuguese and English.
